title: Anonimized IPhO 2026 Theory scores and T1 solution complexity
description:
Dataset and data processing script for the article "Effectiveness of low level problem solving strategies for high ability students: Insights from the 56th Physics Olympiad."

Experimental scores and student codes are not included in accordance with Article 6 of the statutes: "Results of those candidates who only receive a certificate of participation should strictly remain to the knowledge of the Members of the International Board and persons allowed to attend its meetings."
